title.en: Woven cloth with yarn direction and scale

summary: Connect weave orientation and yarn scale to cloth panels while keeping surface appearance distinct from drape mechanics.
objective: Make a woven cloth panel retain coherent yarn direction and readable finish through folds.
intent_signals: Make a woven cloth panel retain coherent yarn direction and readable finish through folds.
example_prompts: Create a woven cloak whose thread direction follows the cut panels and whose hems remain readable at portrait distance.

principles: Separate panel construction and drape geometry from the small-scale yarn/fiber appearance. A sheen control alone does not create a weave or solve cloth mechanics.
Direction-dependent cloth appearance can be modeled at different detail levels; a fiber-volume renderer is not required for a stylized textile.
implementation: Assign two local weave directions to each panel and carry them through the surface coordinates. At seams, allow deliberate changes of panel orientation instead of forcing one global projection.

Model folds and hem thickness in geometry. Use explicit yarn crossings only for views that resolve them; at greater distance use filtered texture or an effective response and check that repeating lines do not dominate.

Rotate a strip light around a flat swatch and then the draped panel. Compare broad reflectance changes separately from visible weave texture and tune fine roughness without changing the fold silhouette.
observable_checks: The chosen warp/weft pattern follows a panel across a fold and changes only at an intended seam or pattern boundary.
At the delivery camera distance, the weave reads as fabric rather than oversized rope or flickering checkerboard; reduce detail when unresolved.
Pausing motion leaves the texture attached to the cloth surface rather than drifting through world space.

known_limits: No elasticity, bending stiffness, friction, tear resistance or complete fiber-level light transport is inferred from the finish.
Authored modeling and inspection guidance; no runtime artifact or improvement has been observed for this record.
creative_affordances: Painted checks, exaggerated chunky weave or simplified smooth cloth can preserve panel direction without a prescribed shader.

claims.statement: Irawan and Marschner's woven-cloth model relates appearance to fiber characteristics, yarn geometry and weave pattern, and compares view/light-dependent reflectance and texture against measurements.
claims.scope: Author-reported woven cloth appearance model; not a model of stretch or drape.
